sections.label: § 41-2992.04 - Polygraph examiners advisory board; termination July 1, 1992
sections.text:
41-2992.04.
Polygraph examiners advisory board;  termination July 1,  1992
A. The polygraph examiners advisory board terminates on July 1,  1992.
B. Title 32,  chapter 27,  article 1 is repealed on January 1,  1993.
